## What does this change?

Describe the change and link the issue it addresses.

## Checklist

- [ ] Substantial feature or design changes have a linked discussion
- [ ] Relevant checks passed (`./gradlew build` for code/build changes; links and paths for docs)
- [ ] Runtime changes include appropriate in-game verification, or explain what was not tested
- [ ] The change stays agent-agnostic (no hard-wired models, services, or agent frameworks in the mod)
